title.narrative: Promoting Environmental Sustainability and Community Resilience through Permaculture and Responsible Tourism

description.narrative: This activity strengthens civil society capacity and supports environmentally sustainable livelihoods through permaculture and responsible tourism. It works with local communities, women entrepreneurs, youth, and tourism actors to improve sustainable land use, seed conservation, and climate-resilient practices. Training, practical demonstrations, and awareness campaigns promote environmental protection and inclusive participation in decision-making. The organization also strengthens its internal governance and management systems to ensure accountable and effective implementation. The overall aim is to contribute to resilient communities and more sustainable development practices.
